name: BatchNormalizeLatent and normalize-shuffle
plain: Aligns all samples in a batch to shared channel statistics, for flicker across a batch. A separate node high-passes, z-scores and rotates channels (1,2,3,0), hard-coded to 4 channels.
math:
per channel c: σc,μc over batch; each sample (x−μi)/σi·σc+μc; lerp factor
NormalizeShuffle: optional x−gauss(x); per sample per 4 channels z-score; channels permuted 1,2,3,0
label: from code
surprise: LatentNormalizeShuffle loops range(4) and permutes 4 channels at nodes.py:1885, dropping channels above 4 on Flux-type latents.
